doc.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006

title: Opening: Sherm and the longest-playing alumni band
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the interview, calls him Sherm, and notes the Alumni All-Stars are the nation's longest-playing alumni band.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in the Browsing Room on campus. I’m very pleased to have Dick Sherman with me today, class of ’53.
And I can call you Sherm on camera?
Okay Sherm. It’s a pleasure to have you here on your annual trek to Hamilton for you guys.
Fifty years, that’s amazing. And it says here, in print, that you are the nation’s longest playing alumni band.
